main_effects.RNA: top-512 M2R2 fold-local standardized linear Cox

orthogonality_claim: empirical batch covariance penalty only; no strict RKHS-ANOVA claim

schedule.embedding_coordinate_system: one final outer-train ABMIL fit shared by all rows

selection: for every outer fold, Stage-A RNA/ABMIL is fit on inner-train only; Stage-B candidates are fit on those inner-train outputs and scored once on inner-val; outer-test is evaluated once after configuration lock
stacking_bias_control: Additive and interaction training use outer-train cross-fitted scalar main risks; independent fold-specific ABMIL embeddings are never concatenated
